instruction: I keep a monthly log of total expenses I made on Amazon in a SimpleNote note. Update it with this month's entry.
notes: Supervisor's app passwords are fetched first; simple_note login + search_notes locates the monthly Amazon expense log note and show_note reveals its line format ("- <Month> => $<amount>") so the new entry matches. amazon login + show_orders (paginate as needed) yields this month's (May 2023) order totals, which are summed into the new entry. The note is updated via add_content_to_note with append so only the content field changes and the title line remains first; no notes are created or deleted. complete_task takes no answer since the task is not a question; its note/month parameters are task records only.

plan: (simple-note-add-content-to-note amazon-expense-log-note append entry-line-2023-05 amazon-token month-2023-05 amount-2023-05-total)
